description: Measures warp/wave shuffle instruction throughput for four variants: __shfl_xor (butterfly), __shfl (indexed), __shfl_up (shift up), and __shfl_down (shift down). Each thread performs a dependency chain of shuffle ops. Reports effective data movement rate in GB/s.

scaling_param.name: ops_per_thread
scaling_param.description: Number of shuffle operations each thread performs per kernel invocation

non_scaling_params.name: num_blocks
non_scaling_params.description: Number of thread blocks in the grid

non_scaling_params.name: shuffle_variant
non_scaling_params.description: Which shuffle instruction variant to benchmark
